name: Rifath Scot

attributes.attribute: worked on the Tower of Babel

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Rifath Scot is an Irish hero. The Book of Invasions names him an ancestor of the Irish people. He worked on the Tower of Babel. When God scattered the builders across different tongues, Rifath began to speak Scots Gaelic. His descendant Gidal shaped the final form of the language.
